precepts.text: There be nine things which I have judged in mine heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that hath joy of his children; and he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy. A man that hath joy of his children. Our brothers and sisters that have lost their husbands, that have lost their sons, they do not get to have the joy of their children. Their children are hanging on trees. Their daughters are hung on trees. Lives extinguished. They are not getting to enjoy their children. You are supposed to have joy of your children, but because an enemy has taken your children from you, hung your children on trees, murdered your children, you do not get that joy. And he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy. To see the fall of your enemies is therapy. God's therapy.
precepts.point: Verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth. Surely a man could say, surely there is a reward for your trauma, for the evils that have happened to us. God is going to give that to us. That is therapy. We talk about people with trauma and all that. God has given us therapy right there.

note.label: The Waters of Noah Will Be Fire

precepts.why:
“The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance.” Christianity will make you think you are not supposed to read this, but the Bible has it in there for you to rejoice. When you get to see your enemies get it, the people who have been oppressing us and doing all kinds of terrorist acts, and you get to see them get that justice, that's rejuvenation. It revitalizes your bones. “he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked”: that means smashing skulls and vertebrae and rib cages with your feet. That's a good thing. That's therapy.

The Bible names the great things we should look for, and one is joy of children: “There be nine things which I have judged in mine heart to be happy, and the tenth I will utter with my tongue: A man that hath joy of his children.” Our brothers and sisters who have lost their husbands and their sons don't get the joy of their children. Their children are hanging on trees; their daughters are hung on trees; lives extinguished. You are supposed to have joy of your children, but because an enemy has taken them from you, hung them on trees, murdered them, you don't get that joy.

“and he that liveth to see the fall of his enemy.” To see the fall of your enemies is therapy, God's therapy. People don't like it; give a damn. We talk about people with trauma; God has given us therapy right there.

That's why verse 11 begins with so: it gives the reason the vengeance of verse 10 is necessary. “So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.” Surely there is a reward for our trauma, for the evils that have happened to us, and God is going to give it to us. When he beautifies the meek with salvation, it is us putting our enemies in chains and taking vengeance on them. Christianity isn't going to teach you that; these lying pastors and this Christianity garbage will completely destroy our people if we don't pull our heads out of it. And understand, if you teach that you want justice and vengeance, the enemy will call you hateful, and affliction comes with it. Program your mind for that. Don't think you can teach that the white man is the wicked of the earth and he'll leave you alone.

note.label: Destroyed by Familiar Hands

precepts.why:
“He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.” Venezuela is a peaceful country. America put an embargo and sanctions on Venezuela for twenty years to destroy its economy; the money goes down, everything goes down. Then twenty years later: he is a drug dealer, he is this, he is that; people of Venezuela, we can change your lives. America did that. “The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart.”

Only the simple will believe it was about drug trafficking. Trump pardoned one of the biggest drug dealers a couple of months before, and Mexico, on America's border, has more drug cartels than any place in the world. Then the story shifted to oil. They use the same stupidity because they know some black people will believe that garbage. Ninety-nine point nine percent of the words that come out of the Trump mouth are a lie. He lies even when he is not talking; he is blinking and lying, and every person who works for him too.

David shows why: “The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.” The little baby is born, he does not even talk yet, and he is looking at you lying. That is Trump: before he can say a word he already starts lying. All of them. God said it, not me: it is in them to be liars. And our people believe them, because they are white. Who told you the white man cannot lie?

Habakkuk describes the same man, whose “soul which is lifted up is not upright in him.” Esau is not right: “he is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he is in everybody's business, with bases around the world used to overthrow any government that does not do what he says. He destroys the economy with sanctions, sends in CIA agitators and propaganda to raise the people up, and then comes back as the good guy offering to help. Like a man who rapes a woman and then offers to take her to therapy.

That is putting forth his hands against such as be at peace with him. The wicked go astray from the womb speaking lies, and his smooth words always have war in his heart.

precepts.text: He comes from Edom with dyed garments, having trodden the winepress alone, treading them in His anger so their blood is sprinkled on His raiment, for the day of vengeance is in His heart.
precepts.point: The Most High is going to lay His vengeance upon Edom by the hand of His people Israel, His battle axe, and there will be so much death that everyone has to pitch in and bury them for seven months. That is a beautiful thing.

note.label: Psalm 58: The Righteous Shall Rejoice When He Seeth the Vengeance

precepts.why:
“The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.” Isaiah sees who comes from that vengeance: “Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.” He comes from Edom with dyed garments.

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat? I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.” He treads Edom in his anger so their blood is sprinkled on his raiment. “For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.” That is the vengeance the righteous rejoice to see, and the blood of the wicked they wash their feet in.

precepts.text: The Most High will lay His vengeance upon Edom by the hand of His people Israel, and they shall know His vengeance.
precepts.point: The Most High is going to lay His vengeance upon Edom by the hand of His people Israel, His battle axe, and there will be so much death that everyone has to pitch in and bury them for seven months. That is a beautiful thing.

note.label: Psalm 58: The Righteous Shall Rejoice When He Seeth the Vengeance

precepts.why:
“And I will lay my vengeance upon Edom by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall do in Edom according to mine anger and according to my fury; and they shall know my vengeance, saith the Lord God.” The Most High is going to lay his vengeance upon Edom by the hand of his people Israel, his battle axe. Israel does in Edom according to his anger and his fury, and Edom shall know his vengeance.

That is how the righteous wash their feet in the blood of the wicked: the vengeance is the Most High's, and it comes by Israel's hand. Then a man shall say, verily there is a reward for the righteous, and a God that judgeth in the earth. That is a beautiful thing.

precepts.text: The house of Israel will bury Gog and all his multitude for seven months to cleanse the land, so much death that the passengers set up signs by the bones for the buriers.
precepts.point: The Most High is going to lay His vengeance upon Edom by the hand of His people Israel, His battle axe, and there will be so much death that everyone has to pitch in and bury them for seven months. That is a beautiful thing.

note.label: Psalm 58: The Righteous Shall Rejoice When He Seeth the Vengeance

precepts.why:
“Therefore, thou son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus saith the Lord God; Behold, I am against thee, O Gog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal”. When the vengeance comes, “I will give unto Gog a place there of graves in Israel, the valley of the passengers on the east of the sea: and it shall stop the noses of the passengers: and there shall they bury Gog and all his multitude: and they shall call it The valley of Hamon–gog.”

“And seven months shall the house of Israel be burying of them, that they may cleanse the land. Yea, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a renown the day that I shall be glorified, saith the Lord God.” There will be so much death that everyone has to pitch in and bury them for seven months. They sever out men of continual employment to pass through the land and bury those that remain, and “when any seeth a man’s bone, then shall he set up a sign by it, till the buriers have buried it in the valley of Hamon–gog.”

The righteous rejoice when they see that vengeance, and it is a renown to Israel the day the Most High is glorified. That is a beautiful thing, and a man shall say, verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
